items_all.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
items_all.reader_summary: llama.cpp makes it possible to run multi-modal LLMs across a wide range of hardware - from consumer-grade local machines to high-end enterprise servers. Through quantization, optimized backends, and a portable C/C++ implementation, we make AI inference accessible at every level of the software stack. We believe this is the most lightweight, versatile and sensible platform for building cross-platform and private AI products.
items_all.summary_zh: llama.cpp 讓在各種硬體上執行多模態 LLMs 成為可能——從消費級的本地機器到高階企業伺服器。透過量化、最佳化的後端以及可攜式的 C/C++ 實作，我們讓 AI 推論在軟體堆疊的每個層級都易於使用。我們相信這是建構跨平臺與隱私 AI 產品最輕量、最具多功能性且最合理的平臺。

items_all.summary: Jensen Huang likely left Nvidia more because of risky business practices than anything else, a Wall Street Journal report suggests. items_all.title: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
items_all.summary: OpenAI is taking a second shot at AI-powered shopping with ChatGPT Wallet after scrapping its first approach, Instant Checkout. Users register a card once and confirm each purchase through Face ID or a fingerprint, while actual card details stay hidden behind payment tokens. Rivals such as Anthropic, Meta, and xAI already have their agents making purchases. The article OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 在放棄其第一種方法 Instant Checkout 後，透過 ChatGPT Wallet 再次嘗試人工智慧驅動的購物。使用者註冊一次卡片後，即可透過 Face ID 或指紋確認每筆購買，而實際的卡片詳細資訊則隱藏在支付代幣後面。諸如 Anthropic、Meta 和 xAI 等競爭對手已經有其代理程式在進行購物。

items_all.title: Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
items_all.summary: Chinese investors are shut out of Anthropic's IPO, Bloomberg reports. Banks are rejecting buy orders from mainland China and Hong Kong, citing U.S. export control rules known as ITAR. Similar restrictions applied during SpaceX's IPO, and Anthropic's products aren't available in either region anyway. The article Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 《彭博社》報導，中國投資人被排除在 Anthropic's 的 IPO 之外。銀行以稱為 ITAR 的美國出口管制規則為由，拒絕來自中國大陸和香港的買入委託。SpaceX的 IPO 期間也適用類似的限制，而且 Anthropic's 的產品在兩個地區本來就無法使用。

items_all.title: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
items_all.summary: Anthropic's new Claude for Manufacturing plugin connects the AI directly to Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, and Infor. Its 17 specialized skills let the AI draft quotes, compare suppliers, and place backup orders when deliveries are delayed, all after human approval. The plugin doesn't control physical machines yet, but Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard for that. The article Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic's 用於製造業的 Claude 外掛程式將 AI 直接連線到 Autodesk Fusion、Oracle NetSuite 和 Infor。其 17 項專業技能讓 AI 能夠在獲得人工核准後，起草報價單、比較供應商並在交貨延遲時下達備份訂單。該外掛程式目前尚未控制實體機械，但 Anthropic 正在為此單獨開發模型硬體標準（Model Hardware Standard）。

items_all.title: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
items_all.summary: US public-sector unions are increasingly pushing through protections against AI surveillance and automated firings. In Oakland, a strike vote forced retraining programs instead of layoffs, and a transport union in Ohio won veto power over autonomous vehicles. California banned so-called bossware. All of this is happening while nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already use generative AI. The article Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 美國公部門工會正日益推動針對 AI 監控和自動化解僱的保護措施。在奧克蘭，一次罷工投票迫使資方實施再培訓計畫以取代裁員，而俄亥俄州的一個運輸工會則贏得了對自動駕駛車輛的否決權。加州禁止了所謂的「老闆軟體」（bossware）。所有這些都在近 70% 的美國政府機關已經使用生成式 AI 的同時發生。

items_all.title: Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI
items_all.summary: Meta's AI agent Muse can now call businesses on behalf of paying US subscribers, handling everything from cable providers to restaurants. The agent already has over 10 million users, according to Meta's AI chief Alexandr Wang. Google Gemini, Instinct, and xAI's Grok Bot offer the same feature, but many businesses hang up as soon as they detect an AI on the line. items_all.title: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限
items_all.summary: 一場網路攻擊，從取得受害系統的存取權限，到透過多個AI Agent協同執行攻擊，最後大規模蒐集存取憑證，可能不到六小時就能完成。攻擊者不再只是逐步尋找漏洞、手動執行攻擊，而是利用AI串聯不同階段的工作，在短時間內擴大攻擊規模。 Google威脅情報小組（Google Threat Intelligence Group，GTIG）技術長Shane Huntley指出，AI並未從根本上改變網路攻擊的本質，卻讓攻擊者能以更快的速度、更大的規模執行既有攻擊。過去受限於人力與時間，攻擊者必須選擇目標；如今AI可以協助搜尋漏洞、分析系統及執行攻擊，企業原本認為風險不高的弱點，也可能成為入侵入口。

items_all.title: 黃仁勳辭去Nvidia執行長立刻生效，財務長Colette Kress接任臨時執行長、董事會任命首任董事長
items_all.summary: Nvidia董事會11月12日宣佈，黃仁勳辭去Nvidia總裁、執行長暨董事職位，立即生效。由現任執行副總裁暨財務長Colette Kress擔任臨時執行長。Nvidia也任命了首任董事長。 Kress也將持續兼任執行副總裁及財務長一職，直到找到繼任者為止。而Nvidia董事會已經著手尋找接任執行長，同時考量公司內、外部人選。 12日美國股市開盤Nvidia股價一度重挫10%，公司市值跌破4兆美元。而對手AMD股價則大漲27%。

items_all.title: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
items_all.summary: Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that moves KV caches and weights across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage and network. Google reports over 90% lower KV transfer latency on 235B to 480B MoE models. The post Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Google 發布了 TPU Sync，這是一個開源的 C++ 程式庫，可在 TPU HBM、主機 DRAM、儲存設備和網路之間移動 KV 快取與權重。Google 報導指出，在 235B 至 480B MoE 模型上，KV 傳輸延遲降低了 90% 以上。

items_all.title: Claude 輔助完成 19 萬行代碼，成功對三元哥德巴赫猜想進行形式化證明

items_all.title: datasette-leaflet 0.3
items_all.summary: Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3 OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header . Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy. datasette-leaflet is the plugin that loads a bundled Leaflet so other Datasette plugins can depend on it. It now sets the referrer policy on the tile requests themselves to strict-origin-when-cross-origin , passing the host but not the full path to the page. Tags: leaflet , datasette , openstreetmap

items_all.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
items_all.reader_summary: Truly useful AI assistants need to be able to help users who ask misguided questions—not just users who ask the right question with the right amount of detail. We’re releasing XYBench , a benchmark of 8K+ questions that tests how AI assistants respond to requests based on misconceptions, such as asking how to thicken frosting that keeps sliding off cupcakes when the real problem is that the cupcakes are still too warm to frost. XYBench won the Best Resource Paper Award at EMNLP 2026.
items_all.summary_zh: 真正實用的 AI 助理需要能夠協助提出誤導性問題的使用者，而不僅僅是那些用適當詳細程度提出正確問題的使用者。我們推出了 XYBench，這是一個包含 8K+ 個問題的基準測試，用於測試 AI 助理如何回應基於誤解的請求，例如詢問如何讓從杯子蛋糕上滑落的糖霜變濃稠，但真正的問題是杯子蛋糕還太溫暖而不適合塗糖霜。XYBench 在 EMNLP 2026 上榮獲最佳資源論文獎。

items_all_raw.title: Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents
items_all_raw.summary: Vercel Labs released Vercel UI SDK, an Apache-2.0 beta library of 50+ UI behaviors. Coding agents compose them into accessible components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components, with a bridge for direct UI control. The post Vercel Releases UI SDK: 50+ UI Behaviors for AI Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Vercel Labs 發布了 Vercel UI SDK，這是一個包含 50 多種 UI 行為的 Apache-2.0 授權測試版函式庫。編碼代理程式可將它們組合成為 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components 的無障礙元件，並具備用於直接 UI 控制的橋接器。

items_all_raw.title: datasette-leaflet 0.3
items_all_raw.summary: Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3 OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header . Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy. datasette-leaflet is the plugin that loads a bundled Leaflet so other Datasette plugins can depend on it. It now sets the referrer policy on the tile requests themselves to strict-origin-when-cross-origin , passing the host but not the full path to the page. Tags: leaflet , datasette , openstreetmap

items_all_raw.title: Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls
items_all_raw.summary: Chinese investors are shut out of Anthropic's IPO, Bloomberg reports. Banks are rejecting buy orders from mainland China and Hong Kong, citing U.S. export control rules known as ITAR. Similar restrictions applied during SpaceX's IPO, and Anthropic's products aren't available in either region anyway. The article Banks bar Chinese and Hong Kong investors from Anthropic IPO over US export controls appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 《彭博社》報導，中國投資人被排除在 Anthropic's 的 IPO 之外。銀行以稱為 ITAR 的美國出口管制規則為由，拒絕來自中國大陸和香港的買入委託。SpaceX的 IPO 期間也適用類似的限制，而且 Anthropic's 的產品在兩個地區本來就無法使用。

items_all_raw.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
items_all_raw.reader_summary: Truly useful AI assistants need to be able to help users who ask misguided questions—not just users who ask the right question with the right amount of detail. We’re releasing XYBench , a benchmark of 8K+ questions that tests how AI assistants respond to requests based on misconceptions, such as asking how to thicken frosting that keeps sliding off cupcakes when the real problem is that the cupcakes are still too warm to frost. XYBench won the Best Resource Paper Award at EMNLP 2026.
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 真正實用的 AI 助理需要能夠協助提出誤導性問題的使用者，而不僅僅是那些用適當詳細程度提出正確問題的使用者。我們推出了 XYBench，這是一個包含 8K+ 個問題的基準測試，用於測試 AI 助理如何回應基於誤解的請求，例如詢問如何讓從杯子蛋糕上滑落的糖霜變濃稠，但真正的問題是杯子蛋糕還太溫暖而不適合塗糖霜。XYBench 在 EMNLP 2026 上榮獲最佳資源論文獎。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic's new Claude for Manufacturing plugin connects the AI directly to Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, and Infor. Its 17 specialized skills let the AI draft quotes, compare suppliers, and place backup orders when deliveries are delayed, all after human approval. The plugin doesn't control physical machines yet, but Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard for that. The article Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
items_all_raw.summary: US public-sector unions are increasingly pushing through protections against AI surveillance and automated firings. In Oakland, a strike vote forced retraining programs instead of layoffs, and a transport union in Ohio won veto power over autonomous vehicles. California banned so-called bossware. All of this is happening while nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already use generative AI. The article Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 美國公部門工會正日益推動針對 AI 監控和自動化解僱的保護措施。在奧克蘭，一次罷工投票迫使資方實施再培訓計畫以取代裁員，而俄亥俄州的一個運輸工會則贏得了對自動駕駛車輛的否決權。加州禁止了所謂的「老闆軟體」（bossware）。所有這些都在近 70% 的美國政府機關已經使用生成式 AI 的同時發生。

items_all_raw.summary: Meta's AI agent Muse can now call businesses on behalf of paying US subscribers, handling everything from cable providers to restaurants. items_all_raw.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
items_all_raw.reader_summary: llama.cpp makes it possible to run multi-modal LLMs across a wide range of hardware - from consumer-grade local machines to high-end enterprise servers. Through quantization, optimized backends, and a portable C/C++ implementation, we make AI inference accessible at every level of the software stack. We believe this is the most lightweight, versatile and sensible platform for building cross-platform and private AI products.
items_all_raw.summary_zh: llama.cpp 讓在各種硬體上執行多模態 LLMs 成為可能——從消費級的本地機器到高階企業伺服器。透過量化、最佳化的後端以及可攜式的 C/C++ 實作，我們讓 AI 推論在軟體堆疊的每個層級都易於使用。我們相信這是建構跨平臺與隱私 AI 產品最輕量、最具多功能性且最合理的平臺。

items_all_raw.title: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
items_all_raw.summary: Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that moves KV caches and weights across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage and network. Google reports over 90% lower KV transfer latency on 235B to 480B MoE models. The post Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google 發布了 TPU Sync，這是一個開源的 C++ 程式庫，可在 TPU HBM、主機 DRAM、儲存設備和網路之間移動 KV 快取與權重。Google 報導指出，在 235B 至 480B MoE 模型上，KV 傳輸延遲降低了 90% 以上。

items_all_raw.title: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限
items_all_raw.summary: 一場網路攻擊，從取得受害系統的存取權限，到透過多個AI Agent協同執行攻擊，最後大規模蒐集存取憑證，可能不到六小時就能完成。攻擊者不再只是逐步尋找漏洞、手動執行攻擊，而是利用AI串聯不同階段的工作，在短時間內擴大攻擊規模。 Google威脅情報小組（Google Threat Intelligence Group，GTIG）技術長Shane Huntley指出，AI並未從根本上改變網路攻擊的本質，卻讓攻擊者能以更快的速度、更大的規模執行既有攻擊。過去受限於人力與時間，攻擊者必須選擇目標；如今AI可以協助搜尋漏洞、分析系統及執行攻擊，企業原本認為風險不高的弱點，也可能成為入侵入口。

items_all_raw.title: 黃仁勳辭去Nvidia執行長立刻生效，財務長Colette Kress接任臨時執行長、董事會任命首任董事長
items_all_raw.summary: Nvidia董事會11月12日宣佈，黃仁勳辭去Nvidia總裁、執行長暨董事職位，立即生效。由現任執行副總裁暨財務長Colette Kress擔任臨時執行長。Nvidia也任命了首任董事長。 Kress也將持續兼任執行副總裁及財務長一職，直到找到繼任者為止。而Nvidia董事會已經著手尋找接任執行長，同時考量公司內、外部人選。 12日美國股市開盤Nvidia股價一度重挫10%，公司市值跌破4兆美元。而對手AMD股價則大漲27%。

items_all_raw.title: 比高端型號還猛卻更便宜，Google 用"Gemini 4 Hydrogen"上演反向內卷
items_all_raw.summary: Google推出Gemini4Hydrogen（氫），主打速度與執行效率，卻意外壓過定位更高的Argon：第三方智能指數榜Hydrogen得51分，Xhigh檔54分，高於Argon的50分。其默認檔速度達上代Flash的2.5倍，胡編亂造減少超80%，API價格還低於Argon。Google同時推出Antigravity Orchestrator，可在同一任務中按進展自動切換模型，避免兩塊招牌各自爲戰。

items_all_raw.title: Claude 輔助完成 19 萬行代碼，成功對三元哥德巴赫猜想進行形式化證明
items_all_raw.summary: 人工智能正以形式化證明改寫基礎科研。獨立開發者Charlie Reams藉助Claude Code，完成三元哥德巴赫猜想的形式化證明，累計產出19.4萬行且零sorry的Lean4代碼，所有數學推理均經機器嚴格驗證。過程中，AI展現出超越人類傳統審稿的嚴謹性，自主揪出並修補13年前的11處漏洞，凸顯其在數學驗證中的強大能力。
